name: Notion
tagline: Docs, databases, wikis, and workspace content.
shortDescription: Workspace docs and databases with an API for pages, blocks, users, comments, and database items.
agentSummary: Agents can update structured docs and databases through the API, and use Notion MCP for OAuth-based read/write workspace access in supported clients.
bestFor: Knowledge bases, content operations, lightweight CRMs, and docs automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Permission setup and page sharing rules are easy to get wrong. Project, CRM, document, and spreadsheet writes depend on team context and privacy rules; require least-privilege scopes and review for workflow-changing actions. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public seat-based pricing with free and team plans.
authModel: Internal integrations, OAuth, page/database sharing, and hosted Notion MCP OAuth.
browserSupport: Browser UI is central for database design and permissions.

capabilities.detail: API supports pages, databases, blocks, users, and comments.
Notion's hosted MCP server supports OAuth-based read and write access to Notion pages and workspaces for compatible agents.
API docs are readable and example-oriented.
Public seat-based pricing with free and team plans.
Workspace permissions and content layout are easier in browser.
